title: Baked Cha Siu Bao with Sea Bass
description: A fusion twist on the classic cha siu bao, featuring sea bass as the main protein. The zesty and herb flavors will transport you to a culinary adventure.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Prepare the cha siu bao dough according to the package instructions.
Cut the sea bass fillets into 4 equal pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together zesty hoisin sauce and chinese five-spice powder.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the sea bass pieces.
Place a piece of sea bass onto each bao dough circle.
Top with chopped green onions and grated ginger.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the sea bass is cooked through.
